name: Rio de Janeiro
tagline: A city that hugs the ocean and dares it to leave.
journal:
Rio is a verb. People dance to bossa playing out of a stranger's apartment window two floors up; someone joins; the bus driver waves.

I hiked Pedra Bonita at dawn — twenty minutes up, a flat slab of rock at the top, and the whole coast spread out underneath like someone had folded a map.

Later, açaí in a bowl that could feed two. A guy on the beach selling cheese on a stick, grilled over hot coals he carried in a shoebox.
